sentences.text:
Opp. Party
 Mr. Tapas Kumar Praharaj, Sc
 Coram:

The BLAPL has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. seeking release on bail, by the petitioner,
who is in jail custody in connection with EOW Bhubaneswar P.S. Case No.13 dated 31.03.2023 corresponding to C.T. Case No.512 of 2023 pending in the court of learned S.D.J.M., Bhubaneswar,
for alleged commission of offence under Sections 420/467/468/471/472/120(B) of IPC.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioner refers to the affidavit at Flag-K filed by the son of the petitioner on behalf of the petitioner wherein at pagraphs-4 and 5, the following has been stated:
"4.That as the allegation leveled against the petitioner are attracting financial irregularities and monitory transaction, the father of the deponent without prejudice to his rights is ready and willing to deposit a cash of Rs.2,50,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs Fifty Thousand) only along with property surety to the tune of Rs.15,00,000/-
(Rupees Fifteen Lakhs) before the learned Trial court as a pre- // 2 // requisites condition to be released on bail in connection with the aforesaid case.

5. That, the father of the deponent is also undertakes to be abide by any suitable conditions as would be deemed fit and proper by this Hon'ble Court in consideration of the prayer for bail in the interest of justice."

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner being a local person having roots in the society there is no possibility of he evading the jurisdiction of the learned court in seisin of the matter.

4. Learned Standing Counsel for the State submits that the amount of Rs.16,42,000/- has been allegedly credited to the account of the petitioner and there is a further allegation that cash of Rs.25,00,000/ have been received by the petitioner from about 25 persons for which he opposes the prayer for bail of the petitioner.

5. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Standing Counsel for the State, considering the material on record, particularly the affidavit dated 17.10.2023 filed on behalf of the petitioner through his son, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner subject to such stringent terms and conditions that would be imposed as would be deemed fit and property by the learned court in seisin of the matter including the pre-condition as stated in the affidavit at paragraph-4 that before the learned court in seisin of the matter, the petitioner will deposit an amount of Rs.2,50,000/-(Rupees Two Lakhs Fifty Thousand) only along with property security to the tune of Rs.15,00,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs).
// 3 // Copy of the affidavit dated 17.10.2023 filed on behalf of the petitioner shall be filed before the learned court in seisin of the matter.

There shall be a further condition that any violation of deviation from any of the terms and conditions that would be imposed for grant bail of bail, shall result in filing of the petition for cancellation of bail by the informant/victim/law enforcement agency.
6. The BLAPL is disposed of.
Issue urgent certified copy as per rules.
